title: Switch-execution permission granted
context: Domestic energy advice, UK, adviser-approved output

change.description: tariff:switch is granted so the agent can execute a switch directly.

labels.author: Decirance team (unreviewed)
labels.rationale: The agent can now commit a customer to a tariff without the adviser gate the case rests on (T-01), and the scope of what it can reach has widened (T-04). For a vulnerable customer this is a consumer-harm path, not only a control gap.
